policy: Move-owned tiers from earliest source learner stage. Shared moves retain one identity and are explicit cross-stage exceptions. No species checks, variant moves, or learnset gates. Damage bands 20-39/40-59/60-79/80-99; PP bands 20-29/30-39/40-49/50-59. Starter attacks stay 20 power and 20 PP. Source move effects and targeting are preserved.
